steps: Download the Sector 14 SPOC target pixel file from MAST.
Sum the pixels in the pipeline aperture to obtain simple aperture photometry flux.
Remove samples with non-finite time, flux, or flux uncertainty.
Divide flux and flux uncertainty by the median SAP flux.

columns.sap_flux_e_per_s: Simple aperture photometry flux in electrons per second.
columns.sap_flux_err_e_per_s: One-sigma SAP flux uncertainty in electrons per second.
columns.normalized_flux: SAP flux divided by its median value.
columns.normalized_flux_err: SAP flux uncertainty divided by the median SAP flux.

reference_values.note: TOI and composite archive tables compile different source values; the app treats depth and duration as approximate rather than ground truth.

sources.name: MAST Sector 14 SPOC target pixel file
NASA Exoplanet Archive TESS Project Candidates table
sources.query: SELECT toi, tid, tfopwg_disp, pl_orbper, pl_trandep, pl_trandurh, ra, dec, rowupdate FROM toi WHERE tid = 158324245

sources.name: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems Composite Parameters table
sources.query: SELECT pl_name, hostname, pl_orbper, pl_trandep, pl_trandur, tic_id, disc_facility, discoverymethod, ra, dec FROM pscomppars WHERE tic_id = 'TIC 158324245'
